title: Kobitz: US recovered multiple craft, including Roswell, Aztec and Kingman

tellings.quote: What he told me was that he'd been told that the United States had recovered multiple craft.

plain: The United States is said to have recovered several crashed craft in the 1940s and 50s, among them the ones said to have come down at Roswell and Aztec in New Mexico and at Kingman in Arizona. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels that a man named Nat Kobitz, who worked in Navy research, told him he had himself been told the US "had recovered multiple craft." So the claim reaches the show at two removes, and if true it would mean the government has held more than one such object for decades.
